title: Tag Validator
description:
Given a code snippet, return whether it is valid under these rules. - The entire snippet must consist of one closed root tag, with no text outside it. - A closed tag has the form `TAG_CONTENT`. Start and end names must match, and nested tags must close in reverse opening order. - A tag name contains only uppercase English letters and has length 1 through 9. - Content may contain text, valid nested tags, and CDATA sections. Every `<` outside CDATA must begin a valid start or end tag or a CDATA section. - A CDATA section has the form ``. Its content ends at the first subsequent `]]>` and may contain any characters, which are not parsed as tags. CDATA may appear only inside an open tag. ## Examples ### Example 1 ```text Input: code = '
This is the first line ]]>
' Output: true ``` ### Example 2 ```text Input: code = '
>> ![cdata[]] ]>]]>]]>>]
' Output: true ``` ### Example 3 ```text Input: code = ' ' Output: false ``` ## Constraints - 1 <= code.length <= 500 - code consists of English letters, digits, '<', '>', '/', '!', '[', ']', '.', and ' '.
